items.title: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Adds Digital Asset Custody Deal And Data Center Risk Tool
items.summary: Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE: ICE) partnered with Abra, with ICE Digital Trust providing custody for assets used in Abra's crypto-backed lending. The custody structure separates institutional collateral from Abra's lending activities to reduce rehypothecation risk for borrowers. ICE introduced a Data Center Site Analytics Tool to assess risk and feasibility for large data center projects before capital is committed.
